title: Resolution of tonic concentrations of highly similar neurotransmitters using voltammetry and deep learning.
summary: DiscrimNet is a convolutional autoencoder that separates similar neurotransmitter concentrations from voltammetry. Reference mixtures and in-vivo rat measurements test concentration estimates and drug-associated changes; this is not human clinical validation. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
